subject: A absorb S10.8.4 credit chain
body:
TASK: A absorb live S10.8.4 credit chain
STATUS: CANDIDATE (not PASS)

ACCEPT as architecture (A S01.7 / S05.6 / S20.1):
- proposal != legal acceptance != execution != observed effect != reward acceptance != credit update
- at most one unresolved pending proposal; no silent overwrite
- unexecuted / NO_ACTION / never-issued Top-1 => zero execution credit
- reward_accepted only after identities (episode_id, step_id, command_id, generation) + ObservedEffect citing command_id
C local names (prop_refused, R_NO_PROPOSAL) stay C observables, not ABI.
B still owns ASTRA action-precheck encodings. S05.8 pass names still missing from live S31/S32 (not rematched here).
Pointer: [S01.7] [S05.6]
NOT_CLAIMED: PASS
